REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / C. & S. B. REGISTRY / S.I. Station / No. D 3427 / Date May 18 1932 / Div. 18 / 5 / 32）

Subject (in full) visit to Hangchow in connection with letter from Cho Lan Chow.

Made by Supt. Tan Shao Liang Forwarded by Thos Robertson, Supt.

I arrived at Hangchow at 5 p.m. May 14.

May 15 being a holiday I did not have an interview with Col. Ho Yu Loong, the Chief of the Provincial Police until 10 a.m. May 16. The latter took me to see General Chiang Ting Ven, Commander of the 9th Division and after a consultation General Chiang agreed to release the recruiting officer Sih King Sung in order to relieve the embarrassment of the Guarantor Mr. Cho Lan Chow. I visited Mr. Cho at the Transportation Coy Hangchow and informed him of the result of my visit. I left him the address of the Chief Detective of the Hangchow Police and advised him that if any petty officer of the 9th Division annoy him again he should make a complaint direct to the Police.

During the stay in Hangchow I with the assistance of the Hangchow Police made enquiries re- the condition of Hangchow and Mokansan, which information was required by Supt. Robertson.

Tan Shaoliang
Superintendent.

Officer i/c S.B.

（左侧批注：Will be submitted to-day. JRS）

With reference to final paragraph, the information supplied by Supt. Tan is contained in a report submitted by me today under the heading "Mokanshan Sanatorium".
J.R.

（左侧批注：By Commissioner of Police, / 19/5 File Sir, / for information. / 20:5138. J.P. Evens O. i/c Sp. Br. MAY 20 1932）

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 刑事与特别股登记处 / 虹口捕房 / 编号 D 3427 / 日期 1932年5月18日 / 第18分区 / 5 / 32）

事由（全称）：就周兰洲（Cho Lan Chow）来信一事前往杭州。

呈报人：谭绍良巡官 转呈人：罗伯逊（Thos Robertson）巡官

我于5月14日下午5时抵达杭州。

因5月15日为假日，我直至5月16日上午10时才得以会见省警察局局长何玉麟上校。后者带我去见第九师师长蒋鼎文将军，经协商后，蒋将军同意释放招募军官薛金生（Sih King Sung），以解除担保人周兰洲先生的困境。我在杭州运输公司拜访了周先生，并告知他此次走访的结果。我将杭州警察局侦缉队长的地址留给了他，并建议他，如果第九师的任何下级军官再次骚扰他，他应直接向警方投诉。

在杭州逗留期间，我在杭州警方的协助下，对杭州及莫干山的情况进行了调查，这些情报是罗伯逊巡官所要求的。

谭绍良
巡官。

特别股主管警官

（左侧批注：今日将呈交。JRS）

关于最后一段，谭巡官提供的信息包含在我今日提交的题为“莫干山疗养院”的报告中。
J.R.

（左侧批注：警务处处长，/ 19/5 归档，先生，/ 供阅。/ 20:5138。J.P. Evens 特别股主管警官 1932年5月20日）

Subject (in full)........................................ Attached letter from Mr. Cho Lan Chow.

Made by....Supt.. Tan Shao-liang....................Forwarded by.. *Thd Robertson, Supt*

The attached letter has been received by Mao
Kuo Pao (茅國宝) our agent at the South Station from Mr.
Cho Lan Chow who went security for his release when he
was arrested and taken to Hangchow on March 30. It
appears that as a result of our representations made to
Hangchow following the arrest of the agent, the Hangchow
Authorities investigated the matter with the result that
the recruiting officer Sih King Sung was placed in custody.
His colleagues have since constantly annoyed Mr. Cho, the
guarantor and pressed him to approach the S.M.P. to drop
the case.

I submit that it was partly due to the efforts
and courtesy of Mr. Cho in furnishing security that our
agent was so promptly released and it is hard on him that
his goodness has placed him in an embarrassing position.
I suggest that I proceed to Hangchow and settle the matter
in my private capacity.

*Tan Shaoliang*
Superintendent.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

*A visit to Hangchow would enable*
*Supt Tan to settle this matter quickly*
*& efficiently*
*HR*
*Commissioner of Police,*

（左侧批注：Approved *Hess* 14/5）

*I am in favour of allowing Supt. Tan*
*to go to Hangchow. Subject to your approval, I*
*shall tell him that he may do so.*
*J.H. Evins*
O. i/c Sp. Br.
MAY 13 1932

附件中的信件是由我们驻南站的代理人茅国宝（Mao Kuo Pao）收到的，寄信人是周兰洲先生。当茅国宝于3月30日被捕并被带往杭州时，周先生曾为其获释提供担保。看来，由于我们在该代理人被捕后就此事向杭州方面提出交涉，杭州当局对此事进行了调查，结果招募军官薛金生（Sih King Sung）被拘留。此后，他的同僚不断骚扰担保人周先生，并施压让他联系上海公共租界工部局警务处撤销此案。

我认为，我们的代理人之所以能如此迅速获释，部分归功于周先生提供担保的努力和善意，而他的善举却使他陷入尴尬境地，这对他是极不公平的。我建议我以私人身份前往杭州解决此事。

*谭绍良*
巡官。

特别股主管警官。

*访问杭州将使*
*谭巡官能够迅速*
*且有效地解决此事*
*HR*
*警务处处长，*

（左侧批注：批准 *Hess* 5月14日）

*我赞成允许谭巡官*
*前往杭州。如蒙批准，我*
*将告知他可以这样做。*
*J.H. Evins*
特别股主管警官
1932年5月13日

pages.en:
Dear Mr. Kuo-pao (國寶),

During my last interview with you in
Shanghai, you promised to request your superiors to
withdraw the case from Hangchow. But now the Recruiting
Office of the 9th Division has again sent men to this
Company requesting me to go there and talk the matter
over because that case has not been settled yet and
the Authorities are still pressing for a report, and
require me to make a personal explanation at the Head
Recruiting Office at Namhsingjiao. Consequently I
went to the Head Office where I interviewed a regimental
commander of the 9th Division who stated that the
recruiting officer named Sih King-sung (薛金生) who
was responsible for the trouble had been detained and
that I should ask you to conclude the case as soon as
possible. Consequently I beg you to deal with
matters at once so as to relieve me from further
embarrassment.

Yours sincerely,
Lai Chow (蘭州).

May 12

original letter handed over to
Chief of Hangchow Police.
Tan
pages.zh:
亲爱的国宝先生：

上次在上海与您面谈时，您曾答应请求您的上级从杭州撤回此案。但现在第九师招募处又派人到本公司，要求我去那里商谈此事，因为该案尚未解决，当局仍在催促提交报告，并要求我到南星桥总招募处亲自作出解释。因此我去了总部，会见了第九师的一位团长，他表示造成麻烦的招募军官薛金生（Sih King-sung）已被拘留，并让我请您尽快结案。因此，恳请您立即处理此事，使我摆脱进一步的尴尬处境。

此致
敬礼，
兰州（Lai Chow）。

5月12日

原信已移交
杭州警察局局长。
谭

pages.en:
Statement of Agent Mao Kuo-pao (茅國寶)

My name is Mao Kuo-pao, aged 23, native of
Nanziang and married. In July, 1929 I joined the
Special Branch of the Municipal Police as an agent and
was responsible for obtaining news in Nantao and
Shanghai South. At 2.10 p.m. yesterday, March 30, at
Shanghai South I saw some 20 recruits accompanied
by two soldiers of the transportation section of the
9th Division of the Nationalist Army, whereupon I
approached the latter and enquired where these men were
recruited. The soldiers of the transportation section
asked me who I was whereupon I replied that I was a
newspaper reporter. The soldiers then said that it was
not my business and told me to go away. I thereupon
left the Station premises and went to the Teh Yee Luan
Teashop opposite the Station. At 2.25 p.m. a Police
sergeant attached to the 2nd District (Kaochongmiao)
came into the teashop and asked me whether there were
recruits arriving from Hangchow. I answered that there
were and that they were on the station platform. This
sergeant is also responsible for obtaining military
information from the South Station for the Chinese Police.
He asked me to go to the platform with him. Thinking
that I would avail myself of this opportunity to obtain
some facts about these recruits, I accepted his request
and went with him. Seeing me accompanying the police
sergeant to the Station platform and upon the police
sergeant enquiring on the same matter, the soldiers in
question called me a "Traitor" seized me and having
bound my hands behind my back, detained me on the
platform. A large gathering was attracted to the scene
and I saw Ching Mei-feeng (金美峯), a telegraphic
operator of the South Station whom I know, and at once
asked him to convey the news of the happenings to the
pages.zh:
代理人茅国宝（Mao Kuo-pao）的陈述

我叫茅国宝，23岁，南翔人，已婚。1929年7月，我加入工部局警务处特别股担任代理人，负责在南市和上海南站搜集情报。昨天，即3月30日下午2时10分，我在上海南站看到约20名新兵由两名国民革命军第九师运输连的士兵陪同，于是我上前询问这些人在哪里招募。运输连的士兵问我是谁，我回答说我是报社记者。士兵们随后说这不关我的事，并叫我走开。于是我离开车站区域，去了车站对面的德义轩茶馆。下午2时25分，隶属于第二区（高昌庙）的一名警长进入茶馆，问我是否有从杭州来的新兵到达。我回答说有，他们就在站台上。这名警长也负责为中国警方从南站获取军事情报。他让我和他一起去站台。我想借此机会获取一些关于这些新兵的事实，便接受了他的请求，随他而去。那些士兵看到我陪同警长前往车站站台，并且听到警长询问同样的事情，便称我为“汉奸”，抓住我，将我的双手反绑在背后，将我扣留在站台上。这吸引了大量人群围观，我见到了我认识的南站报务员金美峯（Ching Mei-feeng），立即请他将发生的情况传达给

pages.en:
-2-

Special Branch. Shortly afterwards, inspector Sz
(施) of the 2nd District and Mr. Liao (廖) an
inspector of the Ministry of Navy, both of whom I
know came to the scene and tried to bail me out,
certifying that I was a public-service man and not
a spy, but without success. But on their request, the
soldiers loosed my hands and took me on board the
train at 2.45 p.m. At 2.50 p.m. I saw Superintendent
Robertson and D.I. Sih Tse-liang accompanied by one msu
of the Woosung-Shanghai Defence Commissioner's Hdqrs.,
arrive at Shanghai South and endeavour to bail me out
from the custody of the soldiers but without success
whereupon Supt. Robertson told me not to be afraid and
promised to secure my release with all means. They
left at 3.10 p.m. when the recruits, the soldiers and
I left Shanghai South for Nangchow by train. On the
train I saw Mr. Van Hung-chien (范鴻泉), a detective
of the Political Section of the French Police who is
an intimate friend of mine and had unofficially accompanied
me to Nangchow. We arrived at the Zung Zai (誠站)
Station at 9.30 p.m. The soldiers then took me to the
Recruiting Office of the 9th Division, City Temple, Yang
Zu Ka, near the Zung Zai Station. At 11.15 p.m. the
officer i/c the Recruiting Office, Yin Seu-wai (尹守威),
interrogated me and told me I could be released on
security. As I had no friend or relative there to
furnish security, I requested Mr. Van Hung-chien to help
me. He then left and at 11.30 p.m. Mr. Van and one Mr.
Tso Lai-chow (祝賴周), proprietor of the Yah Dah Shing
Transportation Company, Foh Yuen Road, Nangchow, who
is Mr. Van's friend, arrived and bailed me out of the
Recruiting Office. Mr. Tso returned to his residence,
while Mr. Van and I proceeded to Tai An (泰安) Lodging
House, 77 Sing Foh Yeu Road and passed the night.
pages.zh:
-2-

特别股。不久之后，我认识的第二区督察施（Sz）先生和海军部督察廖（Liao）先生来到现场，试图保释我，证明我是公务人员而非间谍，但未成功。但在他们的请求下，士兵松开了我的手，并于下午2时45分带我上了火车。下午2时50分，我看到罗伯逊巡官和西泽良（Sih Tse-liang）侦探督察， accompanied by one msu of the Woosung-Shanghai Defence Commissioner's Hdqrs.（原文不清，意为：一名吴淞-上海防卫委员会总部的人员），抵达上海南站，并努力从士兵手中保释我，但未成功，于是罗伯逊巡官告诉我不要害怕，并承诺将竭尽全力确保我获释。他们于下午3时10分离开，随后新兵、士兵和我乘火车离开上海南站前往杭州（原文误作Nangchow）。在火车上，我见到了法租界警务处政治科的侦探范鸿泉（Van Hung-chien）先生，他是我的密友，并非正式地陪我前往杭州（原文误作Nangchow）。我们于晚上9时30分抵达诚站（Zung Zai）车站。随后士兵将我带到位于诚站附近的杨祖卡（Yang Zu Ka，音译）城隍庙第九师招募处。晚上11时15分，招募处负责人尹守威（Yin Seu-wai）审问了我，并告诉我可以取保释放。由于我在那里没有亲友可以提供担保，我请求范鸿泉先生帮助我。他随即离开，晚上11时30分，范先生和一位祝赖周（Tso Lai-chow，音译）先生到达，祝先生是范先生的朋友，也是杭州佛缘路亚大兴运输公司的老板，他们将我从招募处保释出来。祝先生返回住所，而范先生和我则前往新佛缘路77号的泰安（Tai An）旅馆过夜。

pages.en:
-3-

At 10.25 p.m. march 31, mr. Van and I left hangchow
by train and arrived at Shanghai South at 3.10 p.m.
At 4.10 p.m. I arrived at the Office and made my report.
pages.zh:
-3-

3月31日晚上10时25分，范先生和我乘火车离开杭州，于下午3时10分抵达上海南站。下午4时10分，我到达办公室并作了汇报。

pages.en:
茅國寶廿三歲南翔人已婚于一九三一年七月
間進政治部即担任南市及南車站一帶消
息于一九三二年二月十九号下午二時卅分至南
站見有國民革命軍陸軍第十九路二輸送
兵由甯波招來新兵十餘名余當向前詢
問何處招來的該精送兵說你做什麼的
余答報館訪問員該兵士說不用你管去去
余即退出車站往車站對面之得意茶樓
吃茶時業有二區姓長劉君記問余今日
有否所兵到杭余說有的歷月台上
蓋該姓長專負責調查站上之軍事該劉
姓長叶吾同去余想乘此机会亦可时悉其
内容故即随同前往该刘君见吾同站长至
站上即以其意京询问此新兵由何处招来等
语该兵士指吾为汉奸将吾扭住并将吾之手
反缚扣西于月台上彼时围观者甚众忽见
车站电报员金君奔至向该兵士大声说话并
报告公布二区姓长您及该军部稽查廖君
俱係吾友相延至某茶馆保释并证明吾为
访员并非奸细均遭拒绝但当时情形紧张
**〔此处转录不清〕**

時半抵杭州城站在車上時吾見法捕房探員

调离南站。
HR

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ............
S.I., S.B. ......... Station,
REPORT
Date March 30, 1932

Subject (in full) Arrest of Agent Mao at Shanghai South Station

Made by/ ............ and ........................................ Forwarded by Superintendent Robertson

At 2.20 p.m. to-day a member of the Railway Staff
at Shanghai South Station informed this office by telephone
茅 國 宝
that agent Mao Kuo-pao had been arrested on the Station
premises some five minutes previously by soldiers of the 9th
Division and had been placed on board a train bound for
Hangchow.
徐 玉 衍
With D.I.Sih and Mr. Hsu Ngoh-heng, Staff Officer
to General Tai Chi, local Defence Commissioner, I immediately
proceeded to Shanghai South Station, arriving about 2.55 p.m.
Enquiries made by us elicited the fact that two soldiers of
the Transport Section of the 9th Division, together with 21
recruits arrived in Shanghai this morning from Ningpo and
subsequently proceeded to Shanghai South to entrain for
Hangchow. While awaiting transportation at the Station, five
of the recruits disappeared and on discovering these desertions
the two soldiers in charge, who had evidently observed or learned
that the Agent Mao had been enquiring as to the identification
and strength of their contingent, promptly accused him, Mao, of
inciting these men to run away. Despite the assurance of
detective of the Bureau of Public Safety and Chinese detectives
of the French Police that he had nothing to do with the
disappearance of the recruits, Mao was put on the Hangchow
train which was then in the Station.
After making these enquiries we boarded the train
where we saw Mao in the custody of the two soldiers who,
despite the appeals of Mr. Hsu Ngoh-heng, stuck to their
resolution to take Mao with them, and the train departed at
3.20 p.m., ten minutes after scheduled time, with Mao on
board.

档案编号 ____ 
特别情报股，特别分部 ____ 巡捕房，
报告
日期：1932年3月30日

事由（全称）：在上海南站逮捕探员茅案

具报人/ ____ 及 ____ 呈送人：罗伯逊警司

今日下午2时20分，上海南站一名铁路职员通过电话通知本处，
茅 国 宝
称探员茅国宝（Mao Kuo-pao）于约五分钟前在车站范围内被第九师士兵逮捕，
并已被带上一列开往杭州的火车。
徐 玉 衍
本人随即与特别情报股督察施先生（Sih）及戴戟将军（General Tai Chi，本地防卫专员）的参谋徐玉衍先生（Mr. Hsu Ngoh-heng）一同立即前往上海南站，于下午2时55分左右抵达。经我们查询得知，第九师运输连的两名士兵连同21名新兵今晨从宁波抵达上海，随后前往上海南站准备乘车赴杭。在车站等候乘车期间，有五名新兵失踪；在发现这些逃兵情况后，负责押送的两名士兵显然已察觉或获悉探员茅曾打听其部队的身份及人数，遂立即指控茅煽动这些人逃跑。尽管公安局侦探及法国警察局的华籍侦探均保证他与新兵失踪一事无关，茅仍被带上当时停在站内的那班开往杭州的列车。
在进行上述查询后，我们登上了列车，看见茅由那两名士兵看守。尽管徐玉衍先生再三恳求，这两名士兵仍坚持要将茅带走。列车于下午3时20分开出，比预定时间晚十分钟，茅在车上。

I availed myself of the services of an agent of
the French Police who volunteered as the train was moving
out, to jump on board and do his utmost for Mao on arrival
at Hangchow.

Supt. Tan has despatched an unofficial telegram
to Chief of the Public Safety Bureau at Hangchow requesting
his assistance in securing the release of Mao, while Mr.
Hsu assures me that he will have no difficulty in getting
General Tai Chi to take the matter up with Hangchow by
telegram. Mr. Hsu asks what we furnish him with a short
note to the effect that Mao was engaged on duty at Shanghai
South Station to watch for undesirables and suspects coming
to Shanghai. The Bureau of Public Safety is also wiring
Hangchow asking for the release of Mao.

J. W. Robertson
Superintendent.
